name: HospitalFlow

tables.definition: MIMIC-IV-compatible patient demographics and anchor metadata (synthetic).
tables.sql_definition:
CREATE TABLE "patients"(
        subject_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        gender TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(gender IN ('F','M')),
        anchor_age INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(anchor_age BETWEEN 0 AND 91),
        anchor_year INTEGER NOT NULL,
        anchor_year_group TEXT NOT NULL,
        dod TEXT
    )

columns.name: subject_id
columns.definition: Identifier of the patient represented by this row.
columns.allowed_values: Integer identifier; no positive-only or business min/max CHECK is declared.
columns.value_domain_basis: Declared INTEGER type and applicable key constraints.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: gender
columns.definition: Synthetic demographic category recorded for the patient.
columns.allowed_values: F, M

code_meanings.F: Female category in the synthetic dataset
code_meanings.M: Male category in the synthetic dataset

columns.value_domain_basis: SQL CHECK
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
source_references: HospitalFlow authored business convention and declared schema

columns.name: anchor_age
columns.definition: Age in synthetic anchor_year; not an event.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: anchor_year
columns.definition: Synthetic de-identified reference year.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: anchor_year_group
columns.definition: Approximate original-year group (synthetic).
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: dod
columns.definition: Date of death if known; not an assumed process event.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

tables.definition: Synthetic hospital stay using original MIMIC-IV admissions time-column names.
tables.row_grain: One row per hospital admission, identified by hadm_id.
tables.sql_definition:
CREATE TABLE "admissions"(
        hadm_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(subject_id),
        admittime TEXT NOT NULL,
        dischtime TEXT,
        deathtime TEXT,
        admission_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        admit_provider_id TEXT,
        admission_location TEXT,
        discharge_location TEXT,
        insurance TEXT,
        language TEXT,
        marital_status TEXT,
        race TEXT,
        edregtime TEXT,
        edouttime TEXT,
        hospital_expire_flag INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(hospital_expire_flag IN (0,1)),
        CHECK(dischtime IS NULL OR admittime<=dischtime),
        CHECK(edouttime IS NULL OR edregtime IS NOT NULL),
        CHECK(edouttime IS NULL OR edregtime<=edouttime)
    )

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.definition: Identifier of this particular hospital admission, distinct from the patient identifier.
columns.allowed_values: Integer identifier; no positive-only or business min/max CHECK is declared.
columns.value_domain_basis: Declared INTEGER type and applicable key constraints.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: subject_id
columns.definition: Patient to whom this hospital admission belongs.
columns.allowed_values: Existing patients.subject_id values.
columns.value_domain_basis: Declared SQL foreign key; enforcement requires PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: edregtime
columns.definition: Time of emergency department registration associated with this admission.
columns.allowed_values: UTC timestamp text using the documented format; no additional date range is declared.
columns.value_domain_basis: Documented representation; SQL checks below apply when present.
columns.null_meaning: No emergency department registration time is recorded. Whether an ED registration occurred is unknown.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: admittime
columns.definition: Time when the patient was admitted for this hospital stay.
columns.allowed_values: UTC timestamp text using the documented format; no additional date range is declared.
columns.value_domain_basis: Documented representation; SQL checks below apply when present.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: dischtime
columns.definition: Time when the patient actually left this hospital stay.
columns.allowed_values: UTC timestamp text using the documented format; no additional date range is declared.
columns.value_domain_basis: Documented representation; SQL checks below apply when present.
columns.null_meaning: No discharge time is recorded. Whether discharge occurred is unknown; an ongoing stay cannot be inferred from NULL alone.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/admissions.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.name: deathtime
columns.definition: Actual death timestamp if observed during this admission; NULL in current synthetic cohort.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: edouttime
columns.definition: Time the patient departed the emergency department, as in MIMIC-IV.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: admission_type

source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: insurance
columns.definition: Recorded payor category.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: language
columns.definition: Admission-level language preference, not a patient master attribute.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: marital_status
columns.definition: Marital status at admission.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: race
columns.definition: Recorded demographic classification at admission.
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

columns.name: hospital_expire_flag
columns.definition: Whether death occurred during admission (all zero in synthetic sample).
source_references: Synthetic HospitalFlow; MIMIC-IV hosp schema names (not MIMIC patient records)

constraint_notes: CHECK(dischtime IS NULL OR discharge_authorized_at<=dischtime) rejects a known authorization time later than discharge. When discharge_authorized_at is NULL and dischtime is present, the expression evaluates to UNKNOWN and SQLite permits the row. Authorization is not mandatory for a recorded discharge.

tables.definition: Recorded actions on laboratory, medication or procedure requests, including repeated reviews.

tables.sql_definition: CREATE TABLE labevents(labevent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lab_order(order_id), itemid INTEGER NOT NULL, charttime TEXT NOT NULL, storetime TEXT NOT NULL, valuenum REAL, valueuom TEXT, CHECK(charttime<=storetime))

columns.value_domain_basis: Declared INTEGER type and applicable key constraints.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
columns.description: Authored concept dictionary; no original MIMIC item IDs are claimed.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html
HospitalFlow authored adaptation; local constraints and records are synthetic

columns.allowed_values: UTC timestamp text using the documented format; no additional date range is declared.
columns.value_domain_basis: Documented representation; SQL checks below apply when present.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html#charttime
HospitalFlow records specimen collection in charttime; measurement execution is not represented.

columns.name: storetime

columns.allowed_values: UTC timestamp text using the documented format; no additional date range is declared.
columns.value_domain_basis: Documented representation; SQL checks below apply when present.
columns.null_meaning: NULL is not allowed by the declared schema.
source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html

columns.name: valuenum

source_references: https://mimic.mit.edu/docs/iv/modules/hosp/labevents.html

tables.definition: One patient physical-location interval per record, following the MIMIC-IV transfers table shape.
tables.row_grain: One admission, ward transfer, or discharge location interval.

tables.sql_definition:
CREATE TABLE transfers(
        subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(subject_id),
        hadm_id INTEGER REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id),
        transfer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        eventtype TEXT CHECK(eventtype IN ('ed','admit','transfer','discharge')),
        careunit TEXT,
        intime TEXT,
        outtime TEXT,
        CHECK(outtime IS NULL OR intime IS NULL OR intime<=outtime)
    )

business_rules: A patient can have multiple hospital admissions; hadm_id identifies an admission and subject_id identifies a patient.
Supplementary profile rows use the patient identifier documented in patients; their logical relationship is not enforced by an SQL foreign key.
A signed discharge summary uses the identifier of its hospital admission. Draft documents are not stored in admission_detail.
Laboratory, medication and procedure requests use separate local identifier namespaces.
An order-action history row has exactly one populated order-reference column; repeated reviews are separate records.

A laboratory request can cover several specimens or measurements. For a recorded result the collection time precedes laboratory receipt, which precedes result availability; verification follows the available results.
When a laboratory request has an associated admission, lab_order.subject_id must equal admissions.subject_id for that hadm_id. NULL hadm_id means no associated admission.
A medication prescription can have multiple pharmacy dispensing records; each dispensing can have multiple administration or omission records.

NULL is interpreted by the column-specific rule: an unrecorded clinical timestamp gives unknown occurrence status; a non-applicable order-reference column and an absent admission association have their separately defined structural meanings.
Laboratory charttime represents specimen collection; storetime represents result availability. Medication and procedure storetime values represent system documentation times.
Lab concept codes 1001, 1002 and 1003 mean Creatinine (mg/dL), Sodium (mmol/L) and Hemoglobin (g/dL), respectively.

Business-action codes are namespace-specific. Identical physical codes in different business contexts can mean different actions. Use the code's business definition or referenced code table; do not infer meaning from the raw code alone.

MIMIC-IV-inspired structure with wholly synthetic patients and movements; no original patient record is used.
Patient demographics live only in patients, with admission-specific attributes in admissions.

An interval in transfers is not automatically a separate event for every time column: eventtype=transfer at intime records the care-unit transfer; admit and discharge intervals duplicate admission milestones.
An ED departure event uses admissions.edouttime; admission approval is not inferred. Null deathtime/dod are not events.
